summary: This Form 8-K reports the issuance and sale of a $750,000 convertible promissory note (face value $937,500) by CERO Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. to SRX Health Solutions, Inc. The note bears 10% interest, matures May 28, 2027, and is convertible into common stock at the lower of $0.05 or 80% of the average of the five lowest intraday prices over the prior 20 days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The company will file a resale registration statement. This is a routine debt financing and does not constitute a special-situation event such as a restructuring, going-private, or capital return.
